svg.title: Fig1
svg.desc: KilnBio integrates assay-specific measurements through matched biological units and explicit gene or region maps. Optional genomic and protein annotations remain distinct from measurements. Outputs support research comparisons and experimental follow-up, not clinical diagnosis.
svg.text: Research use / Process, connect, compare and test molecular evidence
Start with raw reads or existing molecular measurements
STAR + RSEM or Salmon; gene counts
STARsolo, cell QC and donor pseudobulk
Olink NPX or processed assay matrices
ONT modBAM, biomodal or beta values
Connect measurements under one research question
fit a shared contrast where valid
Add optional context while keeping evidence types distinct
VEP consequences | ClinVar assertions | AlphaMissense scores
Exact allele / transcript / protein mapping; annotations do not replace measured effects.
Ask what the integrated evidence supports
